QuestInfo.name: Path of the Battle Mage
QuestInfo.0: You decide to become a member of the Resistance in order to fight for peace and freedom. Resistance members can choose from various Jobs to fit their aptitude and taste... You wonder what Jobs are available. Talk to #b#p2151001##k, the Magician Job Instructor, who works as a streetsweeper, to find out more about being a Resistance Magician.
QuestInfo.1:
A Resistance Magician is quite different from a normal Magician. More HP, more buffs, and consecutive attacking skills make the #bBattle Mage#k comparable in speed and power to a Warrior! If you want to become a Battle Mage, talk to #p2151001# again.

#bIf you want to become a different Job, forfeit the quest and talk to another Job Instructor.#k
QuestInfo.2: You've become a Battle Mage! Now, show your courage and stand in the forefront of battle as you fight against the Black Wings as a member of the Resistance!

0.0: It is good to see you here. Allow me to reintroduce myself. I am #p2151001#, Magician instructor of the Resistance. It has been...difficult for me, playing a role that has no semblance of my own personality. Think of it! A Battle Mage who sweeps the streets? Ridiculous! But we must all make sacrifices for our cause.
0.1: Now, you are probably accustomed to Magicians who elegantly cast spells from a distance, but #bBattle Mages#k are...different.
0.2: Battle Mages are Magicians who like to get right up into the heat of battle and fight with #bquick, consecutive magic attacks#k. We are #bmuch better able to defend ourselves than regular Magicians, too.#k
0.3: So yes, we use magic, but we're more like Warriors than Magicians, really. We have an arsenal of #bsecondary magic skills, but they're for attacking#k. We stand on the front line, risking neck and limb to block enemies from getting through. We are fighter Magicians and we are vital to the Resistance.
0.4: Some accuse us of being unconventional, but who cares? The results are what's important, and if our unique set of skills help drive the Black Wings out of Edelstein, no one has a right to complain. So, will you join our ranks? Let me know, now or later, once you've made up your mind.

yes.0: Let me warn you now that being a Battle Mage is far from easy. Short range and complicated controls are but a few of the difficulties we face. Are you sure you want to embark on the path of a Battle Mage?

no.0: Perhaps you can't visualize yourself as a Battle Mage. No matter. I am sure there is another job that will suit your personality. Talk to #p2151002#.
